converse.note: Converse and ConverseStream are API interfaces. The selected model, service tier, token/modality usage and capacity offering determine cost; streaming is not an additional GPU tier.

invokemodel.note: InvokeModel and its streaming variant use the selected model/capacity rate. Native payload differences do not create a separate pricing plan.

params.note: Temperature/top-p/top-k are configuration, not paid plans. Output-token limits, model choice, reasoning settings and retries affect consumed inference usage.

invlog.note: Opt-in capture uses supported CloudWatch/S3 destinations. Budget for destination ingestion, storage, delivery, and queries; check class support for the chosen source.
